lead.headline: Your defence is on bye; the claim closes at 01:00
lead.deck: Claim the Ravens, Chiefs second, Vikings the drop. Everything else is set, and Coker practised on Tuesday.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. The Vikings' defence is still in your lineup on a bye, worth 0.0, and the claim that replaces it processes at 01:00 tonight — this is the last brief before it does. Claim the Ravens (8.2), with the Chiefs (8.1) as a second claim and the Vikings as the drop in both; only Panda Attack are ahead of you in the order. The rest of the lineup is right: Coker and McLaurin went in for Jefferson and Gordon this morning, and Coker took part in Tuesday's practice after the quad. If he is inactive at 09:30 Sunday, Kamara takes the flex. Next week Buffalo, Jacksonville and Washington are on bye — Allen, Tuten and McLaurin — and you carry one quarterback.
